sources.snippet: Do not use tensor-parallel (TP=2) — NCCL all-reduce over PCIe adds more latency than it saves for a 27B model. Each GPU runs its own full vLLM server with --max-num-seqs 8. vLLM's continuous batching handles concurrency within each instance. A lightweight bridge in front routes requests to the least-loaded GPU and handles health checking.
